models.mechanism: The focus now stages two opposed mouth-operations. قُلْ أَعُوذُ is articulated protective invocation directed to the Lord of opening, while the new verse presents repeated light mouth-blows directed into knots. The Lord of الفلق is read as the authority whose opening and clarification undo a breath-act designed to bind; saying refuge is therefore a counter-operation, not merely an audible compass in darkness.

models.mechanism: The controlled-permeability model gains a precise attack mechanism. A nearly immaterial mouth-blow carrying slight moisture is inserted فِي a compact knot; a tiny input can thereby compromise a closed node and affect the larger binding. Refuge with the Lord of الفلق asks for detection and opening of the compromised node, or for its boundary to reject the harmful input while preserving sound bonds.
